PROGRAMS.NAME: undock
PROGRAMS.COMMENT: Timeouts are in milliseconds. SEARCH_TIMEOUT covers looking for the undock button, UNDOCK_TIMEOUT runs from the click until the ship core confirms the ship is in space.

PROGRAMS.NAME: autopilot
PROGRAMS.COMMENT: All values are milliseconds. DESTINATION_TIMEOUT waits for a gate or station icon in the route panel; CMD_SEARCH_TIMEOUT for the jump or dock button that selecting it brings up; ENTER_WARP_TIMEOUT for the warp message to appear after the command; MAX_JUMP_TIMEOUT for it to go away again, which is the whole warp; WARP_RECHECK_PAUSE is the gap between those checks. GATE_JUMP_PAUSE and DOCKING_PAUSE let the session change or the docking animation finish, and DOCKING_TIMEOUT waits for the undock button that proves the ship is inside.
